title: MetroVolt — Firm Power for Data Centers & Cities
headline: Firm power where the load is.
tagline: MetroVolt is the Kronos burner sited for data centers and cities — a D-3He tandem-mirror generator with direct energy conversion that needs almost no water. Design stage; perfected while the breeder is built.

the-machine: The same burner core, in the MetroVolt housing.
data-center-power: Firm 24/7 power for AI compute, co-located with the load.
the-water-story: No steam cycle, so almost no water — answering the data-center water crisis.
grid-and-cities: Dispatchable, baseload, grid-firming, and urban siting.
direct-energy-conversion: Turning charged particles straight into electricity.
readiness-timeline: Design stage now; the path to a commercial fleet.
